goal_intent: book a long table for eight and ask for it to be away from the door

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling to book a long table for a little get-together with friends this weekend.
Yes, we’ll be a group of eight. It’s always such a lively crowd when we all manage to get together!
Absolutely! We’re hoping for Saturday evening, around 7:30pm. It’s always nice to catch up over dinner, especially at that time when everyone’s relaxed.

That all sounds perfect, thank you so much! If it’s possible, could we have our table set away from the door? Sometimes it gets a bit drafty and we’d love to settle in and chat without being disturbed. Other than that, everything sounds wonderful!
